name: Vehicle Registration Certificate (RC)
summary: Track your smart card or paper RC, engine/chassis numbers, and 15-year fitness renewal date.
whatItIs: A Vehicle Registration Certificate (RC) is the official document issued by the Regional Transport Office (RTO) certifying that your motor vehicle is registered with the Government of India. In India, private vehicle registration is valid for 15 years from the initial purchase date, after which it must undergo fitness inspection and re-registration every 5 years.
wherePeopleLoseIt: Most car owners leave the original laminated RC card inside the glove box, where it gets sun-damaged, misplaced during car servicing, or forgotten until a traffic stop. When needed for an insurance claim or vehicle resale, finding the exact registration date or chassis number becomes an ordeal.

criticalDates.name: Initial 15-Year Expiry
criticalDates.description: Private non-transport vehicles in India require fitness renewal upon reaching 15 years.

criticalDates.name: Subsequent 5-Year Re-Registration
criticalDates.description: Fitness certificates must be renewed every 5 years after the initial 15-year lifecycle.

whatVaultExtracts: Owner Name & Vehicle Make / Model (e.g. Hyundai VENUE)
howToUse: Snap a photo of both sides of your RC card (or forward a PDF downloaded from Parivahan/mParivahan) to @squaresvaultbot in Telegram. The bot links the vehicle plate to all future insurance and challan uploads.

faqs.q: Can I show SQUARES Vault's saved RC to traffic police in India?
faqs.a: Traffic authorities legally require the original physical card, DigiLocker, or the mParivahan app during on-road checks. SQUARES Vault is your personal life-admin vault for rapid access, expiry tracking, insurance claims, and service records.

faqs.q: What happens when my RC is close to 15 years old?
faqs.a: SQUARES Vault dispatches proactive reminders before the expiry date so you can book your RTO fitness inspection and avoid running an unregistered vehicle.

faqs.q: Will uploading my RC automatically link my insurance policies?
faqs.a: Yes. SQUARES Vault matches your vehicle registration number across documents. Once your RC is saved, any insurance policy, PUC certificate, or challan carrying that plate is automatically connected under that vehicle.

name: Pollution Under Control (PUC) Certificate
summary: Never pay a ₹10,000 challan for an expired 6-month or 1-year emissions certificate.
whatItIs: A Pollution Under Control (PUC) Certificate confirms that your motor vehicle's emissions comply with national emission standards under the Motor Vehicles Act. New BS-IV and BS-VI vehicles receive an initial 1-year certificate, after which renewals are required every 6 months (or 12 months in select states for BS-VI vehicles).
wherePeopleLoseIt: PUC slips are printed on flimsy thermal paper at roadside testing booths. Within weeks, the thermal ink fades into illegibility, or the paper gets crumpled under seat cushions, leaving drivers unaware that their validity has lapsed.

criticalDates.name: Validity Expiry (6 or 12 Months)
criticalDates.description: The exact date testing validity ends. Driving without a valid PUC invites a statutory penalty of up to ₹10,000 under Section 190(2) of the Motor Vehicles Act.

whatVaultExtracts: Date of Test & Exact Validity Expiry Date
howToUse: Immediately after testing, take a clear photo of the printed paper certificate with your phone and send it to the Telegram bot. SQUARES Vault schedules precision alerts at 10 days, 2 days, and on the expiry day.

faqs.q: Why does PUC tracking matter so much?
faqs.a: Under Indian traffic regulations, driving with an expired PUC attracts a steep fine of ₹10,000 and potential suspension of your driving license for 3 months. In addition, insurance companies may deny own-damage claims if the vehicle lacked a valid PUC at the time of an accident.

faqs.q: Can thermal paper PUC receipts be read accurately by Gemini AI?
faqs.a: Yes. If photographed under decent lighting before the thermal ink fades, Gemini AI reliably extracts the validity date and registration plate.

faqs.q: How does Snooze work when I get a PUC alert?
faqs.a: When SQUARES Vault alerts you that your PUC expires in 2 days, you can tap 'Snooze' to get reminded again the next morning when you are driving past a testing center.

name: Comprehensive & Third-Party Car Insurance
summary: Protect your No Claim Bonus (NCB) and prevent policy lapses with advance renewal warnings.
whatItIs: Motor insurance is mandatory under the Motor Vehicles Act in India. A Comprehensive policy covers both mandatory Third-Party legal liability and Own Damage (accidents, theft, fire, floods), accompanied by optional add-ons like Zero Depreciation, Engine Protection, and Return to Invoice.
wherePeopleLoseIt: Policy schedules are typically emailed as multi-page PDFs by insurers or aggregators. They get buried under thousands of promotional emails. When an accident or breakdown occurs, drivers scramble to locate the policy number, cashless garage helpline, or RSA contact.

criticalDates.name: Annual Expiry Date
criticalDates.description: The exact midnight deadline when coverage ceases. Allowing coverage to lapse by more than 90 days forfeits your accrued No Claim Bonus (NCB) discount (up to 50%).

criticalDates.name: Break-in Inspection Window
criticalDates.description: If renewed after expiry, insurers require a physical inspection before reissuing coverage.

whatVaultExtracts: Policy Start Date & Expiry Midnight Date
howToUse: Forward the policy PDF directly from your email to @squaresvaultbot in Telegram. The bot logs the expiry date, calculates the 10-day renewal alert, and files the original PDF in your Google Drive.

faqs.q: Why is a 10-day reminder critical for motor insurance?
faqs.a: Comparing quotes and porting your policy to a new insurer takes 2–4 days. Receiving an alert 10 days in advance gives you adequate time to negotiate better IDV and add-on rates without risking a midnight lapse.

faqs.q: What happens to my No Claim Bonus if I miss renewal?
faqs.a: If your policy lapses and is not renewed within 90 days of expiry, your entire accumulated No Claim Bonus (which can be as high as 50% discount on own-damage premium) drops to zero.

faqs.q: Does SQUARES Vault mask my policy number?
faqs.a: Yes. Document identifiers are masked in our database indexes to protect your privacy while allowing full retrieval of the original PDF from your Google Drive whenever needed.

name: Health Insurance (Mediclaim & Top-Up)
summary: Preserve waiting-period credits for pre-existing diseases by never missing premium due dates.
whatItIs: Health insurance (individual or family floater) covers hospitalization expenses, daycare procedures, and critical illness treatments. Maintaining continuous renewal is vital in India because statutory waiting periods for specific ailments and pre-existing diseases (usually 2 to 4 years) reset if the policy permanently lapses.
wherePeopleLoseIt: Family health insurance cards and policy schedules are sent as separate PDFs per member. During hospital admission emergencies (TPA desk), relatives waste precious hours searching through phone folders for TPA Member IDs and policy validities.

criticalDates.name: Annual Renewal Date
criticalDates.description: The target date to pay annual premiums.

criticalDates.name: 30-Day Grace Period
criticalDates.description: IRDAI mandates a 30-day grace period for premium payment. While continuity benefits remain protected during grace, no coverage is available for hospitalizations occurring during this unpaid window.

howToUse: Forward the policy schedule document to the bot. Ask 'When does my health insurance renew?' or 'Give me my health insurance policy number' whenever needed at a clinic or hospital desk.

faqs.q: Why is health insurance continuity so valuable in India?
faqs.a: Under IRDAI rules, continuous renewals count toward completing the waiting periods for pre-existing illnesses. If a policy lapses past the grace period, you lose those accrued years and must restart waiting periods from scratch.

faqs.q: Can I share my family health insurance policy with my spouse?
faqs.a: Yes. SQUARES Vault offers Family Access Sharing. You can grant your spouse read-only access to the 'insurance' category so they can retrieve policy details on their own Telegram.

name: Extended Warranties & Annual Maintenance Contracts (AMC)
summary: Exercise free replacement and repair claims before manufacturer warranty windows snap shut.
whatItIs: An Extended Warranty or AMC (Annual Maintenance Contract) extends manufacturer repair coverage for consumer electronics, major kitchen appliances, or vehicles beyond the standard 1-year factory warranty. They protect against expensive repair charges for motherboards, compressor units, and motor assemblies.
wherePeopleLoseIt: Extended warranty certificates are often stapled to the original invoice booklet or emailed as an afterthought by third-party warranty companies. When an appliance breaks 2 years later, owners assume it is out of warranty and pay local technicians out of pocket.

criticalDates.name: Warranty Expiration Date
criticalDates.description: The exact calendar date when free repair/replacement coverage terminates.

howToUse: Take a photo of the warranty booklet or certificate when purchasing the product. SQUARES Vault keeps track of the duration (e.g. 24 or 36 months) and notifies you before the warranty expires.

faqs.q: Can I claim repairs right before the warranty expires?
faqs.a: Yes. Having an alert 10 days before expiry allows you to schedule a preventive service check for noisy fans, failing displays, or battery degradation while replacement is 100% free under warranty terms.

faqs.q: Does SQUARES Vault link warranties to purchase invoices?
faqs.a: Yes. If the appliance name matches, SQUARES Vault's entity recognition links the warranty certificate to the original purchase invoice so you have both ready for service centers.

name: Appliance Invoices & Cash Memos
summary: Preserve proof of purchase for laptops, phones, TVs, and air conditioners for warranty claims.
whatItIs: Retail tax invoices, cash memos, and electronic purchase receipts serve as legal proof of purchase and mark the start date for all consumer warranty claims. Authorised service centers (Apple, Samsung, LG, Sony, etc.) strictly refuse warranty repairs without the tax invoice.
wherePeopleLoseIt: Store receipts are almost universally printed on thermal roll paper. Within 6 to 9 months, heat and ambient light turn thermal paper completely blank, leaving no verifiable proof of purchase when an appliance breaks down in month 11.

criticalDates.name: Date of Purchase
criticalDates.description: Marks the start of the 1-year or 2-year warranty clock.

whatVaultExtracts: Item Purchased & Serial / IMEI Number (if listed)
Date of Purchase & Total Amount Paid
howToUse: The moment you unbox an appliance or receive a tax invoice from an online delivery, snap a clear photo or forward the PDF invoice to @squaresvaultbot. The original file is stored in your Google Drive forever.

faqs.q: What if my thermal store receipt is already fading?
faqs.a: Photograph it immediately under bright natural light. Gemini AI can often reconstruct faint characters that are difficult for human eyes to parse. Once saved to your Drive, the digital copy will never fade.

faqs.q: How does this help during consumer disputes?
faqs.a: Under India's Consumer Protection Act 2019, an invoice specifying the GSTIN, date, and serial number is mandatory for filing redressals in the National Consumer Forum.

name: Traffic Challans & e-Challan Notices
summary: Clear automated camera challans before they get referred to Virtual Courts.
whatItIs: An e-Challan is an electronic notice issued by state traffic police or automated speed/signal cameras for traffic violations (speeding, red light jumping, stop line breaches, or wrong-side driving). Unpaid challans are eventually escalated to Virtual Courts or National Lok Adalats.
wherePeopleLoseIt: SMS alerts sent by transport departments often get filtered into spam or forgotten. Drivers only discover months later that multiple unpaid camera challans have piled up against their registration plate, preventing vehicle sale, fitness renewal, or NOC issuance.

criticalDates.name: Payment Due Date (Usually 60 Days)
criticalDates.description: Window to pay online at the standard compound rate before the notice is forwarded to the Virtual Court.

whatVaultExtracts: Location of Offence & Violation Offence Code
howToUse: Forward the e-challan PDF or snapshot the Parivahan portal receipt to the bot. SQUARES Vault logs the fine, connects it to your car, and schedules reminders so you settle it before court referral.

faqs.q: Can unpaid challans stop me from renewing my RC or selling my car?
faqs.a: Yes. RTO systems block vehicle ownership transfers, fitness renewals, and NOC issuance if any pending e-challans are registered against the vehicle plate.

faqs.q: How does SQUARES Vault link challans to my car?
faqs.a: The bot's entity engine recognizes the vehicle plate on the challan and automatically groups it with your existing car records. When you ask 'Show all records for my Venue', the challan appears with your RC and insurance.

name: Electricity, Water & Piped Gas Bills
summary: Keep proof of residence up to date and pay monthly utilities without late surcharges.
whatItIs: Periodic utility bills (electricity distribution, piped natural gas, broadband, water supply) establish continuous proof of residence for banking, passport verification, and address change applications across India.
wherePeopleLoseIt: Digital utility bills are delivered via SMS links or WhatsApp bots. They get lost in chat histories, leaving residents scrambling to find an active electricity bill under 3 months old when visiting a bank or passport office.

criticalDates.name: Bill Due Date
criticalDates.description: Deadline to pay without late fee surcharges or supply disconnection.

criticalDates.name: Address Proof Validity Window
criticalDates.description: Most Indian authorities (passport offices, banks, UIDAI) require utility bills to be less than 3 months old to qualify as valid proof of address.

whatVaultExtracts: Utility Provider (e.g. BSES, Tata Power, Adani Gas, MGL)
Bill Date & Exact Payment Due Date
howToUse: Forward the monthly bill PDF from WhatsApp or email to @squaresvaultbot. The bot registers the due date and saves the original PDF to your Drive so you always have recent address proof.

faqs.q: Why do Indian authorities demand a bill less than 3 months old?
faqs.a: Proof of residence rules under KYC guidelines mandate recent documentation to confirm the applicant actively resides at the claimed address.

faqs.q: Does SQUARES Vault track historical utility spend?
faqs.a: Yes. You can ask 'How much did I spend on electricity in the last 6 months?' and the bot calculates the total from your indexed records.

name: Passports & Visas
summary: Prevent cancelled international travel with the 6-month validity countdown.
whatItIs: An Indian Passport is issued with a standard 10-year validity for adults. Visas (tourist, business, employment) carry distinct validity periods and permissible lengths of stay.
wherePeopleLoseIt: Passports sit inside locked home safes for months. Travellers often book non-refundable international flights without realizing their passport has under 6 months of remaining validity, resulting in denied boarding at airport immigration.

criticalDates.name: 6-Month International Travel Rule
criticalDates.description: Almost all international destinations and airlines mandate that your passport have at least 6 months of validity beyond your date of departure.

criticalDates.name: Final Expiration Date
criticalDates.description: Date when the passport book becomes invalid for travel and identity verification.

whatVaultExtracts: Date of Issue & Final Expiry Date
howToUse: Photograph the personal particulars page of your passport and send it to the bot. SQUARES Vault flags the critical 6-month pre-expiry milestone so you can apply for reissue smoothly.

faqs.q: What is the 6-month validity rule?
faqs.a: Airlines and immigration authorities across the world (including US, UK, Schengen, UAE, Singapore) will refuse boarding if your passport expires within 6 months of your planned arrival, even if your return flight is immediate.

faqs.q: Is my passport number kept private?
faqs.a: Yes. Identification numbers are masked in our database (e.g. keeping only the last 4 characters). Your original scanned image goes straight to your personal Google Drive.

name: Home Rental & Lease Agreements
summary: Track 11-month lease expirations, notice periods, and security deposit returns.
whatItIs: Residential lease agreements in India are traditionally executed for 11 months to avoid mandatory registration requirements under the Registration Act of 1908. They govern rent payment dates, annual escalation percentages (usually 5% to 10%), notice periods, and security deposit refunds.
wherePeopleLoseIt: Stamp paper lease agreements are kept in bulky physical files or signed electronically via PDF. Tenants and landlords regularly forget the 1-month or 2-month advance notice deadline required to vacate or negotiate extension terms.

criticalDates.name: 11-Month Term Expiry Date
criticalDates.description: The date when the tenancy contract terminates or requires formal renewal.

criticalDates.name: Notice Period Window
criticalDates.description: Typically 30 to 60 days before termination. Failing to serve notice in time can lead to forfeiture of security deposit interest or penalties.

howToUse: Upload the registered or signed PDF of your rent agreement to the bot. SQUARES Vault tracks the 11-month milestone and alerts both parties ahead of the required notice window.

faqs.q: Why are Indian rental agreements usually for 11 months?
faqs.a: Under Section 17 of the Registration Act 1908, leases of immovable property for a term exceeding one year require mandatory registration and high stamp duty. 11-month agreements avoid this statutory friction.

faqs.q: How does the notice period reminder protect tenants?
faqs.a: Most rental contracts specify that failure to provide 30 days written notice before vacating allows the landlord to deduct a full month's rent from your security deposit. SQUARES Vault alerts you well before the notice deadline.
